posts.text: Thank you to all who have been listening to #AmericanColony the last few weeks. As of today, we have 5 episodes with three more releasing each Wednesday until August 19 all at @LatNewsletter.  The response has been amazing, and I will share more soon but THANK YOU for all who sent their kind messages about what is a special series.
